name: dsh-webview
description: Embed the DeepSeek Harness web GUI inside VS Code: attaches to (or auto-starts) the local dsh web server and renders it in a sidebar view and an editor-tab panel.

dshWeb.port.description: Port of the dsh web server to attach to or start.

dshWeb.attachExisting.description: Attach to an already-running dsh web server on the port instead of starting a new one.

dshWeb.spawnIfMissing.description: Start a dsh web server automatically when none is running (uses the checkout launcher below).

dshWeb.checkout.description: Optional path to a deepseek-harness checkout (uses apps/cli/lib/bin.js when present). Leave empty to auto-detect: the dsh CLI on PATH, then npx @deepseek-ai/dsh.

dshWeb.command.description: Optional full command override to launch dsh web (e.g. "pnpm dsh"). Runs via shell with cwd = the first workspace folder; overrides the checkout launcher.

dshWeb.extraArgs.description: Extra arguments appended to the server launch (e.g. --trusted-host).

dshWeb.autoOpen.description: Open the DSH editor-tab panel automatically when VS Code starts.

dshWeb.followWorkspace.description: Restart a self-started dsh server when the first workspace folder changes, so the harness workspace root follows the editor.

dshWeb.stopOnExit.description: Stop the server when VS Code exits (only when this extension started it).
